name: Mu2e detector
notes: technology_classes uses 'spectrometer': the detector's function (momentum/energy analysis of a mono-energetic conversion electron via tracker + calorimeter behind a solenoidal magnet chain) is closer to a spectrometer than to any of the other listed classes (none of which name a solenoidal charged-lepton spectrometer specifically).

2026-09-18: an unsupported 25 m value was removed on verification. 2026-10-29: the Fermilab news feature of 19 May 2023 states "An “S”-shaped, 82-foot-long system of superconducting solenoids" (82 ft = 25.0 m), so the length is stated again, as 82 feet; the status paper does not give a length.

summary.plain: An 82-foot (about 25-metre) system of giant superconducting magnets at Fermilab, with a tracker and a crystal calorimeter downstream, built to catch the single electron that would appear if a muon ever turned directly into one.
summary.technical: Production, transport and detector superconducting solenoids (an 82-foot-long system, about 25 m) with a straw tracker and a pure-CsI crystal calorimeter behind the stopping target, plus a cosmic ray veto system around the last section of the transport solenoid and the whole detector solenoid, per the July 2026 Mu2e status paper and the Fermilab news feature of May 2023. Under construction and installation; initial data collection is scheduled to begin in 2027.

technology.note: Re-sourced 2026-10-29 (changed text). The earlier text called the calorimeter "fast CsI" and gave a "25-metre" chain; the quote below states neither. The status paper's paragraph "The Calorimeter System" (section 2) describes the calorimeter as pure CsI crystals; the Fermilab feature of 19 May 2023 gives the solenoid system as 82 feet long.
technology.quote: superconducting solenoids and high-precision detectors. The solenoid system comprises production, transport, and detector solenoids. ... a straw tracker and a crystal calorimeter, ... a cosmic ray veto system surrounds the last section of the transport solenoid and the entire detector solenoid
technology.value: A system of three superconducting solenoids (production, transport, detector) feeding a straw tracker and a crystal calorimeter, with a cosmic ray veto system around the last section of the transport solenoid and the entire detector solenoid
